'''''A Panoramic Painting - Tatooine''''' was a panoramic [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted the Tatooine landscape, with Jabba's palace being nearby.<ref name="SWG:PVT" />

==Behind the scenes==
This painting was rewarded to the player after completing the [[W:c:swg:Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine|"Panoramic Vistas" collection]], where they have to journey to various locations indicated on a panoramic point. The locations were [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]; a [[The Ranch|ranch]]; [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]]; [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]; the [[Imperial Oasis]]; [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]]; [[Darklighter estate]]; [[the Hilltop]]; an [[Oasis East|abandoned oasis]]; and the [[Krayt Graveyard]].<ref name="SWG:PVT" />
